notes:
Refers to deep, careful thought before making judgments or taking action. A formal word that appears frequently in compound expressions. Composed of {思|し} (think) and {慮|りょ} (consider, ponder).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思慮|しりょ}{深|ぶか}い: thoughtful, prudent
- {思慮|しりょ}⟦{分別|ふんべつ}→分別：20452_funbetsu⟧: prudence and good judgment
- {思慮|しりょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧: lacking in thoughtfulness
- {思慮|しりょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: lacking prudence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配慮|はいりょ}→配慮：07700_hairyo⟧: consideration, thoughtfulness — directed toward others' feelings or needs
- ⟦{熟慮|じゅくりょ}→熟慮：18946_jukuryo⟧: careful deliberation — implies even deeper and more prolonged thought
- ⟦{考慮|こうりょ}→考慮：02752_kouryo⟧: consideration — more neutral, taking something into account
